verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked skyscraper layout. In both, the attribution starts at x≈18 while the quote starts at x≈10, so their left edges don't line up, and the quote mark doesn't align with either. Both also shrink the can to a tiny label you can't read and put the logo row on top of the purple circle's edge, right under the can. A keeps a clear gap between the quote and 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM', as the original does, and keeps the quote block close to its quote mark. B leaves a big dead gap between the quote mark and the quote, then jams the attribution almost against the last line ('soon.'), so the spacing feels top-heavy and cramped.
